```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

SUFFIXES    <- c("full", "mch_neg", "mch_pos", "wt_ctrl")
COND_LABELS <- c(full = "Full cohort", mch_neg = "Het mCh−", mch_pos = "Het mCh+", wt_ctrl = "WT")
COND_PAL    <- c(WT = "#1f78b4", "mCh-" = "#a6cee3", "mCh+" = "#e31a1c")
COND_ORDER  <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")
```

```{r load}
tar_load(scenic_agg_column)
tar_load(scenic_meta_hsc)

# Per-condition AUC matrices (cells × regulons — condition-specific cells & regulons)
tar_load(scenic_auc_mat_hsc_full)
tar_load(scenic_auc_mat_hsc_mch_neg)
tar_load(scenic_auc_mat_hsc_mch_pos)
tar_load(scenic_auc_mat_hsc_wt_ctrl)

# Per-condition clean regulon tables (TF, target, weight)
tar_load(scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_full)
tar_load(scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_mch_neg)
tar_load(scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_mch_pos)
tar_load(scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_wt_ctrl)

# Full-cohort aggregation targets (for shared-regulon heatmap in section 4)
tar_load(scenic_agg_hsc_full)
tar_load(scenic_prop_mat_hsc_full)
tar_load(scenic_hclust_rows_hsc_full)
tar_load(scenic_hclust_cols_hsc_full)
tar_load(scenic_cutree_rows_hsc_full)

auc_list <- list(
  full     = scenic_auc_mat_hsc_full,
  mch_neg  = scenic_auc_mat_hsc_mch_neg,
  mch_pos  = scenic_auc_mat_hsc_mch_pos,
  wt_ctrl  = scenic_auc_mat_hsc_wt_ctrl
)
reg_list <- list(
  full     = scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_full,
  mch_neg  = scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_mch_neg,
  mch_pos  = scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_mch_pos,
  wt_ctrl  = scenic_reg_tidy_hsc_wt_ctrl
)
```

---

# 1 · Regulon inventory

Number of regulons, unique TFs, and target genes inferred per condition.

```{r regulon-inventory}
inv <- imap_dfr(reg_list, function(df, suf) {
  tibble(
    Condition     = COND_LABELS[suf],
    Cells_AUCell  = nrow(auc_list[[suf]]),
    Regulons      = ncol(auc_list[[suf]]),
    Unique_TFs    = n_distinct(df$TF),
    Target_genes  = n_distinct(df$target),
    TF_target_pairs = nrow(df)
  )
})

datatable(inv, rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Per-condition SCENIC output summary",
          options = list(dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE))
```

---

# 2 · Regulon overlap

Regulon sets compared across the three condition-specific runs (excluding `full`).

```{r regulon-sets}
reg_sets <- list(
  `Het mCh−` = colnames(auc_list$mch_neg),
  `Het mCh+` = colnames(auc_list$mch_pos),
  WT          = colnames(auc_list$wt_ctrl)
)

# Intersection summary table
overlap_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "mCh− ∩ mCh+ ∩ WT",  n = length(Reduce(intersect, reg_sets))),
  tibble(set = "mCh− ∩ mCh+",        n = length(intersect(reg_sets[[1]], reg_sets[[2]]))),
  tibble(set = "mCh− ∩ WT",          n = length(intersect(reg_sets[[1]], reg_sets[[3]]))),
  tibble(set = "mCh+ ∩ WT",          n = length(intersect(reg_sets[[2]], reg_sets[[3]]))),
  tibble(set = "mCh− only",          n = length(setdiff(reg_sets[[1]], union(reg_sets[[2]], reg_sets[[3]])))),
  tibble(set = "mCh+ only",          n = length(setdiff(reg_sets[[2]], union(reg_sets[[1]], reg_sets[[3]])))),
  tibble(set = "WT only",            n = length(setdiff(reg_sets[[3]], union(reg_sets[[1]], reg_sets[[2]]))))
)
datatable(overlap_df, rownames = FALSE, caption = "Regulon set intersections",
          options = list(dom = "t"))
```

```{r condition-unique-tfs}
all_shared <- Reduce(intersect, reg_sets)

unique_tfs <- imap_dfr(reg_sets, function(regs, cond) {
  uniq <- setdiff(regs, Reduce(union, reg_sets[names(reg_sets) != cond]))
  tibble(condition = cond, regulon = uniq)
})

cat(sprintf("Shared across all 3 conditions: %d regulons\n", length(all_shared)))
cat(sprintf("Condition-unique regulons: %d\n", nrow(unique_tfs)))

if (nrow(unique_tfs) > 0) {
  datatable(unique_tfs, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            caption = "Regulons unique to one condition",
            options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
}
```

---

# 3 · Mean AUC comparison across conditions (shared regulons)

For regulons present in all three per-condition AUC matrices, compare mean AUC.

```{r shared-auc-comparison}
common_regs <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(auc_list[c("mch_neg","mch_pos","wt_ctrl")], colnames))

mean_auc <- imap_dfr(auc_list[c("mch_neg","mch_pos","wt_ctrl")], function(mat, suf) {
  shared_cols <- intersect(common_regs, colnames(mat))
  tibble(
    regulon   = shared_cols,
    condition = COND_LABELS[suf],
    mean_auc  = colMeans(mat[, shared_cols, drop = FALSE])
  )
}) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean_auc) |>
  mutate(TF = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", regulon)) |>
  arrange(desc(rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)))))

cat(sprintf("Shared regulons across mCh−, mCh+, WT: %d\n", length(common_regs)))

datatable(
  mean_auc |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 5))),
  rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
  caption = sprintf("Mean AUC per regulon across conditions (%d shared regulons)", nrow(mean_auc)),
  options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r auc-scatter-pairs, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
conds <- names(COND_LABELS)[2:4]   # mch_neg, mch_pos, wt_ctrl
pairs <- list(c("mch_neg","mch_pos"), c("mch_neg","wt_ctrl"), c("mch_pos","wt_ctrl"))

plots <- lapply(pairs, function(p) {
  cx <- COND_LABELS[p[1]]; cy <- COND_LABELS[p[2]]
  df <- mean_auc |> select(regulon, TF, x = all_of(cx), y = all_of(cy))
  ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = df |> mutate(d = abs(x - y)) |> slice_max(d, n = 10),
      aes(label = TF), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 15, min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    labs(x = cx, y = cy, title = paste(cx, "vs", cy)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10)
})
wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1)
```

# 4 · RSS per condition (within-condition AUC)

Regulon Specificity Score using each condition's own AUC matrix. Shows which TFs are most specific to each cluster *within* that condition.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Het mCh−

```{r rss-mch-neg, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
cells_neg  <- intersect(rownames(auc_list$mch_neg), scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)
clust_neg  <- setNames(scenic_meta_hsc[[scenic_agg_column]][match(cells_neg, scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)], cells_neg)
rss_neg    <- calc_rss(auc_list$mch_neg[cells_neg, ], clust_neg)
plot_rss(rss_neg, top_n = 5) + labs(title = "Het mCh− — top 5 regulons per cluster")
```

## Het mCh+

```{r rss-mch-pos, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
cells_pos  <- intersect(rownames(auc_list$mch_pos), scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)
clust_pos  <- setNames(scenic_meta_hsc[[scenic_agg_column]][match(cells_pos, scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)], cells_pos)
rss_pos    <- calc_rss(auc_list$mch_pos[cells_pos, ], clust_pos)
plot_rss(rss_pos, top_n = 5) + labs(title = "Het mCh+ — top 5 regulons per cluster")
```

## WT

```{r rss-wt, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
cells_wt   <- intersect(rownames(auc_list$wt_ctrl), scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)
clust_wt   <- setNames(scenic_meta_hsc[[scenic_agg_column]][match(cells_wt, scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)], cells_wt)
rss_wt     <- calc_rss(auc_list$wt_ctrl[cells_wt, ], clust_wt)
plot_rss(rss_wt, top_n = 5) + labs(title = "WT — top 5 regulons per cluster")
```

## Full cohort

```{r rss-full, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
cells_full <- intersect(rownames(auc_list$full), scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)
clust_full <- setNames(scenic_meta_hsc[[scenic_agg_column]][match(cells_full, scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)], cells_full)
rss_full   <- calc_rss(auc_list$full[cells_full, ], clust_full)
plot_rss(rss_full, top_n = 5) + labs(title = "Full cohort — top 5 regulons per cluster")
```

# 5 · AUC UMAPs — top RSS regulons per condition

Top 9 regulons per condition by max RSS across clusters, projected on the global HSC UMAP (SCT embedding). Cells not in that condition's AUC matrix are shown in grey.

```{r umap-prep}
umap_base <- scenic_meta_hsc |>
  select(cell_id, UMAP1, UMAP2, condition)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Het mCh−

```{r umap-mch-neg, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
top9_neg <- names(sort(apply(rss_neg, 1, max), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(9, nrow(rss_neg)))]
df_neg   <- umap_base |>
  left_join(
    as_tibble(auc_list$mch_neg[cells_neg, top9_neg, drop = FALSE], rownames = "cell_id"),
    by = "cell_id"
  )

plots_neg <- lapply(top9_neg, function(reg) {
  df_neg |> arrange(!is.na(.data[[reg]]), .data[[reg]]) |>
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[reg]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours  = c("grey88", "#feb24c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
      na.value = "grey92", name = "AUC"
    ) +
    labs(title = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", reg)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
})
wrap_plots(plots_neg, ncol = 3)
```

## Het mCh+

# 6 · Per-condition AUC heatmaps

Cluster-mean AUC z-scored per regulon. Each tab uses that condition's own SCENIC run (condition-specific regulon set and cells).

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Het mCh−

```{r heatmap-mch-neg, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}
agg_neg  <- scenic_aggregate_auc(auc_list$mch_neg, scenic_meta_hsc, scenic_agg_column)
mat_neg  <- t(scale(agg_neg))
hcr_neg  <- hclust(dist(mat_neg),   method = "ward.D2")
hcc_neg  <- hclust(dist(t(mat_neg)), method = "ward.D2")

draw(Heatmap(
  mat_neg,
  name                 = "z-score\nmean AUC",
  col                  = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166ac","white","#b2182b")),
  cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(hcr_neg),
  cluster_columns      = as.dendrogram(hcc_neg),
  column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_labels           = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", rownames(mat_neg)),
  row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 4),
  border               = FALSE,
  column_title         = sprintf("Het mCh− — %d clusters", ncol(mat_neg)),
  column_title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9)
))
```

## Full cohort

```{r heatmap-full, fig.height=16, fig.width=14}
heat_full <- t(scale(scenic_agg_hsc_full))
col_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Condition mix` = anno_barplot(
    scenic_prop_mat_hsc_full,
    ylim = c(0, 1), bar_width = 0.9,
    gp = gpar(fill = COND_PAL[COND_ORDER], col = NA),
    axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)
draw(Heatmap(
  heat_full,
  name                 = "z-score\nmean AUC",
  col                  = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166ac","white","#b2182b")),
  top_annotation       = col_ann,
  cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(scenic_hclust_rows_hsc_full),
  cluster_columns      = as.dendrogram(scenic_hclust_cols_hsc_full),
  row_split            = length(unique(scenic_cutree_rows_hsc_full)),
  column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_labels           = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", rownames(heat_full)),
  row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 4),
  border               = FALSE,
  column_title         = sprintf("Full cohort — %d clusters", ncol(heat_full)),
  column_title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  row_title_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical")
))
```
